limits: P1 only compile/import/signature verification. No parse, layout, drawing, oracle or formal behavior tests have run for this parser candidate.
No full KaTeX compatibility percentage is claimed. Source registration-to-family mapping is not measured branch coverage.
Unsupported registered names and three pending dynamic macros are preserved in the inventory. Static macros invoking them fail explicitly.

Macro source-specific corner cases remain unverified: noexpand/expandafter semantics, def parameter-text hash-before-brace special case, active-character definitions, futurelet, and optional macro-group edge cases.
Array automatic equation numbering/tags and commutative diagrams are not implemented. Array column-count/strict-warning equivalence and all mode restrictions await independent source tests.
Parser interface currently lacks displayMode/strict/leqno/fleqn options; root layout Options selects visual display style. KaTeX display-only environment restrictions are not asserted equivalent.
Nested text/math switch supports dollar; explicit parenthesis/bracket mode delimiters remain unsupported.
HTML class/id/style/data and includegraphics explicitly reject rather than producing misleading success. href/url retain static text only.
Native parser accepts some direct semantic aliases in addition to source macro rewrites. Complete macro registration inventory beyond main macros.ts is owned by root.
Unsupported literal symbols/codepoints in downstream font metrics must remain an explicit layout error; parser does not substitute a system font.
next: Root freezes all source owners, then announces P2 independent source tests. No tests or product behavior may run before that handoff.
